Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing registered tow truck operators to carry passengers in a vehicle attached to a flatbed tow truck under certain situations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the carrying of passengers in a vehicle attachedto a flatbed tow truck; and amending RCW 46.61.625.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.625 and 1999 c 398 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No person or persons shall occupy any trailer while it is beingmoved upon a public highway, except a person occupying a properposition for steering a trailer designed to be steered from a rearendposition. (2) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, no personor persons may occupy a vehicle while it is being towed by a tow truckas defined in RCW 46.55.010. (3) A registered tow truck operator may allow passengers to ride ina vehicle that is carried on the deck of a flatbed tow truck only whenthe number of people that need to be transported exceeds the seatingcapacity of the tow truck. Drivers and passengers must still complywith RCW 46.61.687 and 46.61.688.
